caption:
Six out of ten calls to small businesses never get answered.

Industry call-tracking research puts the miss rate at roughly 62%, and trades businesses often run higher, closer to 65-70%, because the crew is on the job instead of by a phone.

The part that costs you money: most of those callers never call back. They just dial the next name on the list.

The fix is a text that fires the moment a call is missed, keeping the lead warm until someone can talk.

See it running on a live pipeline. 14 days free, no card.

rationale: Carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B research content, and a dedicated missed-call stat pack (62% unanswered, 85% never call back) is an unclaimed Third-Party Research angle distinct from every prior speed-to-lead, SMS-comfort, and call-answer-rate angle already shipped.
